title: Nonexpansive Bijections in $T_0$-Quasi-Metric Spaces and Their $q$-Hyperconvex Hulls
summary: We study bijective nonexpansive maps in $T_0$-quasi-metric spaces, distinguishing preservation of directed distances from pointwise rigidity. Our focus is their behaviour under passage to the $q$-hyperconvex hull. The upper quasi-metric integers are $q$-plastic and bicomplete, but their hull is the non-$q$-plastic upper real line. An explicit hull calculation and an established metric dense-rigidity theorem give the same failure of inheritance for a $q$-rigid original space.
